report.summary: 4 items planned: verify unresolved symbols (high), fix cache key (high), clarify egress on reads (medium), confirm Python imports merge (medium). All steps use only paths from findings.
risks: If full files define the missing symbols, item 1 is a no-op but the check is still needed to rule out runtime errors.
file_key fix may require coordination with callers that rely on current behavior.
screen_egress implementation may already handle read/write distinction, making item 3 a documentation fix only.
index.py may already merge python_imports; check may reveal no change needed.
todos: After checks, update code or file bugs accordingly.

items.title: Verify all symbols referenced in partial excerpts are defined in their full files
items.why_now: Unresolved symbols would cause runtime NameErrors, blocking any further execution. This is the highest severity and blocks all other work.

steps.verified_by: grep -n 'def platform_supported' containment.py returns a line number
grep -n 'def spec_for' graph_delta.py returns a line number

steps.do: Search for 'def parse_mod' and 'def graph_mod' in the appropriate files (paths unknown; assume they are in parse.py and graph.py respectively)
steps.verified_by: If files exist, grep for definitions; else report missing files

steps.do: Check imports of _advapi32 in the files that reference it

items.assumption: The files containment.py and graph_delta.py exist in the repository root or a known subdirectory. If not, the paths must be located.

items.title: Fix file_key to include language parameter to avoid cache collisions
items.why_now: Cache key omission can cause incorrect caching across languages, leading to wrong analysis results. Confirmed finding, high severity.

steps.do: Add language parameter to file_key signature and include it in the cache key computation (e.g., tuple key includes language)
steps.verified_by: Run existing tests that call file_key and verify the key changes when language differs

steps.do: Update all callers of file_key to pass language argument
steps.verified_by: grep for 'file_key(' and confirm each call includes language

steps.do: Update docstring to reflect actual parameters

items.depends_on: Must know the file containing file_key; settling check in finding suggests checking parse.py or callers.
items.assumption: The file_key function is defined in a file that can be located via grep. The language parameter is available at call sites.

items.title: Clarify screen_egress behavior on read operations in read_pr_thread
items.why_now: Ambiguity could cause unnecessary blocking of reads or incorrect security policy. Medium severity, but blocks correct e2e flow.

steps.do: Inspect implementation of screen_egress in sensitivity.py to see if it distinguishes read vs write
steps.verified_by: Read the function body; look for any parameter or logic that treats reads differently

steps.do: If screen_egress does not distinguish, update docstring to clarify policy scope or modify code to skip egress check on reads if inappropriate
steps.verified_by: Updated docstring or code; run unit tests for read_pr_thread to ensure no regression

items.assumption: sensitivity.py exists and contains screen_egress. read_pr_thread is in a known file (not given).

items.title: Confirm that index.py merges python_imports from parse.python_imports
items.why_now: If Python imports are missing from the index, analysis will be incomplete. Medium severity, but needed for correct indexing.

steps.do: Open daedalus/eval/__main__.py and trace the call to index.py to see if python_imports is merged
steps.verified_by: Read lines 1-30 and any relevant function calls; look for merge or call to python_imports

steps.do: If __main__.py does not call index.py directly, locate the index.py entry point and check its logic
steps.verified_by: grep for 'python_imports' in index.py or related files

items.assumption: The file daedalus/eval/__main__.py exists as cited. index.py exists and is callable.
